title: Sub-Account Direct Trading Prevention (LPOA Lockout)
precondition: Sub-account actively bound to MAM manager.
steps: 1. Investor attempts to manually open an order from personal MT5 terminal.
expected_result: Order rejected by broker server with 'Trade Disabled (Account managed under LPOA)'; investor cannot interfere with manager strategy.
actual_result: OMS validates sub-account permissions; copy/mam trades tagged with copy_kind='mam' distinct from client manual orders.
